items.summary: Philadelphia Semiconductor Index surged 60–64% in six weeks. Broadcom Q1 AI revenue hit $8.4B (+106% YoY) with Q2 guidance at $10.7B and a $100B AI sales target by 2027. Memory chip crisis intensifies with Micron up 38% in one week (best week since 2008); servers account for 60–70% of memory demand versus 30% pre-AI boom.

news.title: Broadcom posts fiscal Q1 AI semiconductor revenue of $8.4B, guides Q2 to $10.7B
CME Group launches compute futures market for GPU pricing hedging

items.summary: Three DOE Reactor Pilot Program units (Aalo, Antares, Valar) received Documented Safety Analysis approval May 2026, on track for July 2026 criticality. U.S. secured largest-ever HALEU shipment (1.7 metric tons) from Japan. DOE awarded $94M for SMR deployments. Terra Power's Natrium plant (Wyoming) provides 500 MW to Rocky Mountain Power; X-energy raised $1B+ in IPO (largest nuclear energy IPO on record).

news.title: Three DOE reactor pilots receive DSA approval, on track for July 2026 criticality
U.S. secures largest HALEU shipment in history from Japan (1.7 metric tons)

items.summary: U.S. secured 100,000 tons of copper plus 50,000 for allies via Orion Critical Minerals Consortium (Feb 2026 Ministerial). Air Force commits to seven E-7A Wedgetail aircraft (backed off 2025 cancellation plans). CBO estimates Trump's missile defense system ('Iron Dome for America') would cost $1.2 trillion over 20 years. Agentic AI adoption accelerating in Pentagon with cybersecurity implications.

news.title: Air Force reverses course, plans purchase of at least seven E-7A Wedgetail aircraft
Pentagon leaders love agentic AI but it's giving cyber criminals nation-state-like powers

items.summary: IDC forecasts 70% of SaaS vendors will shift to consumption/outcome-based pricing by 2028 (seat-based pricing obsolete). Over 40% of large enterprises now scaling agentic deployments beyond pilots. Cognizant launched Secure AI Services (May 7, 2026) for enterprise agentic governance. Deloitte predicts 75% of enterprises will invest in agentic AI in 2026, market CAGR of 53% through 2030 (reaching $45B by 2030 from $8.5B in 2026).

news.title: Cognizant launches Secure AI Services for agentic system governance and scaling
MIT Technology Review: sovereignty is the strongest predictor of enterprise AI success

items.summary: Medicare GLP-1 Bridge extended through end of 2027 (originally Dec 2026). Medvi, AI-powered GLP-1 telehealth startup, hit $401M annual revenue with 250,000+ customers; on track to be a $1B company in 2026. OpenAI launched ChatGPT for Clinicians (May 11, 2026). GLP-1 market continues expansion with new data on cardiovascular and addiction-related applications under development.

news.title: Medicare GLP-1 Bridge program extended through end of 2027
OpenAI launches ChatGPT for Clinicians; AI-powered telehealth startup Medvi on path to $1B valuation

items.summary: Japan Airlines deployed humanoid robots at Tokyo Haneda Airport (May 2026) for three-year operational commitment—industry validation of production-ready systems. SoftBank acquired ABB Robotics for $5.4B, explicitly positioning physical AI as 'next frontier.' Physical Intelligence raised ~$11B in Series C funding. April pi-0.7 demonstrated zero-shot task performance on previously unseen objects. Warehouse automation sector projected €9.5–14.2B by 2026 (15–20% CAGR).

news.title: Japan Airlines deploys humanoid robots at Tokyo Haneda for three-year operational commitment
NVIDIA releases new physical AI models (Cosmos, GR00T) for next-generation humanoid robots

items.summary: Copper added to USGS 2025 critical minerals list (Trump Administration expanded scope). Copper prices reached record $14,500/tonne in January 2026. JP Morgan estimates copper demand from data centers alone will hit 475,000 metric tons in 2026. International Copper Study Group abandoned surplus projections, now forecasting 150,000-tonne deficit for 2026. Supply constraints from geopolitical disruptions (Grasberg, Kamoa-Kakula incidents in 2025).

news.title: Copper prices surge above $14,000 as AI data centers and electrification drive demand
Critical minerals ministerial: U.S. secures 100,000 tons copper via Orion Consortium

items.summary: Canada-TELUS partnership advancing sovereign AI data center cluster in B.C. (to scale 60,000+ GPUs, 150 MW by 2032). Red Hat and Core42 collaborate on sovereign cloud/AI services for UAE public sector (May 11, 2026). IBM Sovereign Core launched for customer-controlled AI workloads. Semidynamics and SiPearl (May 7, 2026) partnering on EU sovereign rack-scale AI platform using European CPUs and accelerators. MIT report finds data sovereignty the strongest predictor of enterprise AI success.

news.title: Canada-TELUS advance sovereign AI factory cluster in B.C. (60K+ GPUs, 150 MW by 2032)
Red Hat and Core42 set standard for sovereign AI infrastructure in UAE
